run_benchmark_sequential: run a multi-agent RL benchmark with MAPPO, QMIX, and MASAC algorithms on VMAS tasks sequentially
create_benchmark: create a Benchmark instance with algorithm configs, VMAS tasks, seeds, and model configs
load_experiment_config: load an ExperimentConfig from the base_experiment YAML configuration file
load_algorithm_configs: load MappoConfig, QmixConfig, and MasacConfig algorithm configs from YAML files
load_vmas_tasks: load VmasTask configurations like BALANCE and SAMPLING from YAML task config files
